channel.description: Latest articles from Palm Coast Observer (observerlocalnews.com)

item.title: Civic League of the Halifax Area installs 2026 board, recognizes award recipients
item.description: Outgoing Chair Nancy Lohman passed the gavel to incoming chair Chris Tolland.

item.title: John Anderson Drive home sells for $2.2M in Ormond Beach
item.description: Built in 1964, the house is a 7/5.5 and has two fireplaces, a pool, an outdoor kitchen, a boat dock, a boat lift, a boat house and 7,092 square feet.

item.title: Fast times, perfect weather at Flagler Palm Coast's 22nd annual East Coast Classic track and field meet
item.description: Sprinters lead the way for second-place FPC boys team.

item.title: Community mourns as missing Palm Coast teen dies in train tragedy
item.description: 16-year-old Khalon Pierre had been reported missing before deputies identified him following a train incident in Bunnell, according to the Flagler County Sheriff’s Office.

item.title: New concrete batch plant gets OK from Palm Coast Planning Board
item.description: The company, Hard Rock Materials, has offered a restricted covenant that would limit its generated traffic trips to 200 per day.

item.title: Transient steals Ormond woman's dolphin statue, says she was going to paint it
Berry nice! Palm Coast Strawberry Festival held at Florida Agricultural Museum
item.description: A portion of the festival proceeds will benefit local Boys and Girls Clubs. Canned goods for Grace Community Food Pantry were also collected.

item.title: AdventHealth Daytona Beach's inpatient rehabilitation program ranked third in the state
item.description: Also: DAB sees record number of passengers screened in one day and dentist celebrates opening of new office in Ormond Beach.

item.title: Flagler Sheriff’s Office finds remains believed to be that of 22-year missing person
item.description: Remains believed to be missing Mary Lou Combs, 41, were found in a car in the Intracoastal Waterway just half a mile from her home in The Hammock.

item.title: Ormond Beach students win awards at statewide Florida Virtual School science fair
item.description: Congratulations to Alyssa Williams, Makenna Green, Annabella Ninivaggi, Jessalyn Goodhand and Sir West!
